items.duty_text: Combine public benefits applications into a single application to the extent permitted by applicable federal or New York State laws or regulations.
Automatically renew public benefits using sufficient information available to the department, to the extent permitted by applicable federal and New York State laws and regulations.

Provide qualifying public benefits without additional applications when income-tax-filing information is sufficient, provide written notice and declination information, and follow the statutory alternative requirements when information sharing or eligibility verification is restricted.

Provide pre-filled applications or renewal applications using applicable income-tax-filing or prior-application information, provide secure online application URLs where applicable, allow paper declination, and follow the statutory alternative requirements when information sharing or eligibility verification is restricted.
Notify pre-qualified filers about applicable public benefits and provide paper or online applications and instructions, including renewal materials where applicable, subject to statutory exceptions.

Determine other public benefits for which an applicant qualifies and provide qualifying benefits without further applications when permitted, renew existing benefits using available information, and provide written notice and declination information.

Provide pre-filled applications or renewal applications using information from the applicant’s initial or last application, provide secure online access where applicable, allow paper declination, and follow the statutory alternative requirements when additional information or verification is required.
Provide notice of potentially qualifying additional public benefits and copies or online access to applicable applications, renewals, and instructions, with an opportunity to decline paper materials.
Accept public benefits applications electronically or by facsimile unless prohibited by federal or New York State law.

Build or commission a system capable of automatically using machine-readable income-tax-filing and public-benefits application or renewal information to screen individuals and fulfill the section’s requirements; develop it under a free/libre/open-source software license; and offer specified governments and municipalities an opportunity to participate in development in exchange for funding.
Provide free language assistance services to limited-English-proficient individuals as required by the chapter.
Provide prompt language assistance during all telephone and in-person interactions and avoid unreasonable additional waiting time.
Translate all covered documents into every covered language.
Determine each applicant’s primary language at initial contact and inform non-English-primary-language individuals in their primary language of free language assistance services.
Include specified notices about free language assistance services in all application and recertification packages in every covered language.
Post conspicuous signs in every covered language at agency and contractor offices informing limited-English-proficient individuals about free language assistance services.
Screen bilingual and interpreter personnel and provide annual training to ensure appropriate language assistance services.
Maintain specified records concerning primary languages, service recipients, language personnel, language determinations, and document translation and dissemination.

items.duty_text: Phase in language assistance services for covered functions according to the specified implementation milestones.
Conduct two trainings per year on best practices for improving interactions between department personnel and members of the public.
Include techniques to improve professionalism, increase cultural sensitivity, and de-escalate conflict in the training.
Provide the training to all appropriate employees, including all employees who interact with members of the public.
Review relevant records and incorporate into CAPS any information required under subdivision b that CAPS does not track, and include that information in the required reports.

items.duty_text: Count time spent in foster care during any 90 days of the previous two years in place of time spent in shelter when determining rental assistance eligibility for a youth in foster care or formerly in foster care, subject to appropriation and other eligibility requirements.

Refer any individual who received an opioid antagonist to combat the effects of an opioid overdose occurring within a HASA facility to appropriate service providers for appropriate additional services.
Establish a pilot program for the design, development, staffing, implementation and provision of social work services at one job center in each borough.

Conduct an audit of operations, policies, and procedures at job centers and SNAP centers, consult with at least five organizations experienced in working with visitors, and respond to their recommendations.
Complete a review of the outreach efforts and services provided to transgender, gender non-conforming and non-binary individuals in domestic violence shelters.

Take measures necessary for implementation of the local law, including promulgating rules, before the law’s effective date.

items.duty_text: Provide monthly rental assistance to an owner or landlord on behalf of a household with a rental assistance voucher according to the statutory calculation, without deducting a utility allowance from the maximum monthly rent.

Develop written parenting resource materials identifying resources available to new parents and guardians, update them periodically and as necessary for accuracy, and provide them to the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene for distribution.
items.deadline_text: periodically and as necessary

items.duty_text: Develop the required parenting resource materials in consultation with specified agencies, organizations, and subject-matter experts.

Provide an automated electronic mail or text message upon approval of an emergency assistance grant application for rental assistance, to the applicant and the building owner or designated managing agent when contact information was provided, including the rental assistance amount, estimated issuance date, and delivery method.

Provide each applicant for cash assistance or supplemental nutrition assistance program benefits with a benefits interview confirmation notice in hard copy or electronically no later than 24 hours after conducting an eligibility or recertification interview; the notice must include a confirmation number, interview date and time, interview location, telephone number from which the applicant received a call if applicable, and other relevant interview information.

items.duty_text: Combine public benefits applications into a single application to the extent permitted by applicable federal or New York State laws or regulations.
Automatically renew public benefits using sufficient information available to the department, to the extent permitted by applicable federal and New York State laws and regulations.

Provide qualifying public benefits without additional applications when income-tax-filing information is sufficient, provide written notice and declination information, and follow the statutory alternative requirements when information sharing or eligibility verification is restricted.

Provide pre-filled applications or renewal applications using applicable income-tax-filing or prior-application information, provide secure online application URLs where applicable, allow paper declination, and follow the statutory alternative requirements when information sharing or eligibility verification is restricted.
Notify pre-qualified filers about applicable public benefits and provide paper or online applications and instructions, including renewal materials where applicable, subject to statutory exceptions.

Determine other public benefits for which an applicant qualifies and provide qualifying benefits without further applications when permitted, renew existing benefits using available information, and provide written notice and declination information.

Provide pre-filled applications or renewal applications using information from the applicant’s initial or last application, provide secure online access where applicable, allow paper declination, and follow the statutory alternative requirements when additional information or verification is required.
Provide notice of potentially qualifying additional public benefits and copies or online access to applicable applications, renewals, and instructions, with an opportunity to decline paper materials.
Accept public benefits applications electronically or by facsimile unless prohibited by federal or New York State law.

Build or commission a system capable of automatically using machine-readable income-tax-filing and public-benefits application or renewal information to screen individuals and fulfill the section’s requirements; develop it under a free/libre/open-source software license; and offer specified governments and municipalities an opportunity to participate in development in exchange for funding.
Provide free language assistance services to limited-English-proficient individuals as required by the chapter.
Provide prompt language assistance during all telephone and in-person interactions and avoid unreasonable additional waiting time.
Translate all covered documents into every covered language.
Determine each applicant’s primary language at initial contact and inform non-English-primary-language individuals in their primary language of free language assistance services.
Include specified notices about free language assistance services in all application and recertification packages in every covered language.
Post conspicuous signs in every covered language at agency and contractor offices informing limited-English-proficient individuals about free language assistance services.
Screen bilingual and interpreter personnel and provide annual training to ensure appropriate language assistance services.
Maintain specified records concerning primary languages, service recipients, language personnel, language determinations, and document translation and dissemination.
